class.name: Transition
class.description:
Transition is a [Resource] that describes a Tween-based animation. Assign it to [member Activity.transition_in] / [member Activity.transition_out] (or the Dialog equivalents) to control how screens appear and disappear.
Supported types: - [code]NONE[/code] (0): no animation - [code]FADE[/code] (1): fade modulate alpha - [code]SLIDE_LEFT[/code] (2): enter from right, exit to left - [code]SLIDE_RIGHT[/code] (3): enter from left, exit to right - [code]SLIDE_UP[/code] (4): enter from bottom, exit to top - [code]SLIDE_DOWN[/code] (5): enter from top, exit to bottom - [code]SCALE[/code] (6): scale + fade combination

method.name: play_enter
method.description: Plays the enter animation on [param node]. Returns the running [Tween], or an invalid ref if [member enter_type] is [code]NONE[/code].

method.name: play_exit
method.description: Plays the exit animation on [param node]. Returns the running [Tween], or an invalid ref if [member exit_type] is [code]NONE[/code].

members.member: Enter animation type. See the [enum Type] constants.
